name: dsh-writing-editorjs-vendor
description: Build inputs for the vendored Editor.js surface shipped inside dsh-writing (lib/vendor/editorjs/). Rebuild: node build.mjs (see packages/dsh-writing/README.md). Never published, and never shipped: a distribution carries lib/vendor/, and this folder is not part of the package's `files` list - the same bargain the vendored Konva surface makes. There is deliberately no package-lock.json and no node_modules: build.mjs reads each artifact straight out of its pinned npm TARBALL, so vendoring needs no install step and no dependency tree.
